limitations: No patient fitting,clinical decision calculator,universal optical calibration or treatment prediction.
Capacity vector and control values are synthetic; ordinary spirometry does not directly measure RV/FRC/TLC.
Steady Fick balance requires representative mixed-venous return,equal blood flows and negligible storage change.
Two-wavelength signal ratio is independent of the synthetic occupancy pool; no CO-specific display is predicted.
No CO pharmacokinetics,unloading kinetics,ventilatory mechanics,shunt or tissue utilization model.
ERS/ATS accessed as substantial indexed full text; direct endpoint403. HO review read at abstract depth only.
Current FDA January2025 guidance is draft as accessed4November2026.
Historical2020 cancer numbers not used as current burden; broad therapy lists and ppm/time/treatment prescriptions excluded.
